title: IntersectionObserver
description: Observe elements and load them as they near the viewport with rootMargin tuning. Defers any asset; triggered by intersection ratio. Example: new IntersectionObserver(cb,{rootMargin:"200px"}).

title: React.lazy + Suspense
description: Split routes into chunks loaded on navigation with Suspense fallbacks. Defers route bundles; triggered by route render. Example: const Page = React.lazy(()=>import("./Page")).
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: dynamic import()
description: import() returns a promise for a module, the primitive behind all JS code splitting. Defers modules; triggered by call time. Example: const m = await import("./heavy.js").
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Virtualized lists
description: react-window renders only visible rows, making 100k-row lists feel instant. Defers offscreen rows; triggered by scroll position. Example: <FixedSizeList height={600} itemCount={100000}>.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Progressive JPEG
description: Progressive scans show a blurry full image first, sharpening as data arrives. Defers detail scans; triggered by byte arrival. Example: jpegtran -progressive.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Blur-up placeholders
description: Tiny blurred thumbnails inline in HTML swap for full images on load (LQIP). Defers full image; triggered by image onload. Example: 20px thumb -> full src.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: prefetch / preload hints
description: Resource hints tell the browser what the next navigation will need. Defers nothing (prioritizes); triggered by hint parsing. Example: <link rel="prefetch" href="/next.js">.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Deferred scripts
description: defer and async let parsing continue while scripts load in the background. Defers script execution; triggered by parse/DOM events. Example: <script defer src="app.js">.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Texture streaming
description: Game engines stream mip levels by distance so VRAM holds only visible detail. Defers high mip levels; triggered by camera distance. Example: UE5 virtual textures.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: LOD meshes
description: Level-of-detail swaps low-poly models in at distance, loading detail on approach. Defers high-poly meshes; triggered by distance threshold. Example: 3 LOD tiers per asset.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Tree-shaking
description: Bundlers drop unused exports at build time so users never download dead code. Defers n/a (removes); triggered by build. Example: rollup/esbuild production build.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: On-demand paging
description: Infinite scroll fetching pages as the user nears the bottom. Defers later pages; triggered by scroll threshold. Example: cursor-based /api/items?after=....
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Lazy hydration
description: Server-rendered HTML becomes interactive only for components entering view. Defers JS hydration; triggered by visibility. Example: astro island directives.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Font display swap
description: font-display: swap renders fallback text instantly, swapping when the webfont loads. Defers webfont; triggered by font load. Example: @font-face{font-display:swap}.
